Title: Azure Container Registry support for Private Link now in preview

Body.Content:
Limit network traffic of resources within a virtual network with Azure Container Registry support for Private Link (In preview).

With Private Link, the registry endpoints are assigned private IP addresses, routing all traffic within a customer-defined virtual network. Take advantage of Azure management of your registry along with the benefits of tightly controlled network ingress and egress by using private network support.

Learn more
